title: UAE Removes Document Requirements for 13 Work Permits
excerpt: The United Arab Emirates has eliminated supporting document requirements for 13 types of work permits to streamline the application process.
body_html: The United Arab Emirates has updated its employment regulations by eliminating the need for supporting documents across 13 different categories of work permits. According to the announcement, this regulatory change aims to simplify and streamline the application procedures within the country. The official update focuses on reducing paperwork for these specific permit types.
